excerpts.finding: All nine paragraphs were visually read, including319at3200px and320at2800px. The opening is elliptical beneath the VisionIII heading. Fifth hour, anticipated place reply, ivory seat, linen cushion and towel, fear/recovery/confession, the woman arriving with six previously seen youths and listening, asking about righteousness for the household, building command, elders, left gesture/grief, bare the Name, perseverance command and sitting/works/endurance promise remain. Cushion kerbikarion, two single-circumflex linoûn forms and imperative meinon correct only import transcription errors. Epestathē in6 is explicitly Hilgenfeld’s conjecture, against Athos estathē and versional stood behind, with Sinaiticus deficient here. No new manuscript selection is made.

All nine paragraphs of the diplomatic transcription were read. Explicit vision noun; bracketed that-woman demonstrative and part of appear verb; fifth hour. The place-choice phrase is repeated before the I-will-come reply. Furniture includes kerbikarion and linen terms. As-before clause remains. Full six-youth arrival/listening block with estathē is present. Household share clause additionally has with yourself. Raising/building/elders remain. Left gesture and grief remain. Name has his; meinon command and sitting/works/endurance promise remain. Printed brackets are not counted as unbracketed surviving letters; no fresh manuscript photograph collation.

All nine explicit ab/app/rdg layers were read; no gap or supplied element occurs. Opening lacks explicit vision noun; fifth hour remains. In3 ca corrects masculine her-pronoun and adds the I-will-come verb. In4 cushion is kerbikarion, ca changes directed-place wording and material spelling, S1/ca remove duplicate connective. In5 several spelling/reflexive corrections occur, and no separate final as-before clause. In6 the first text starts with touching/speaking, lacking the whole arrival/six-youth/standing/listening block; ca adds connective and speech pronoun and changes some-share-of-it to with-yourself wording. In7 raised-by-hand/building remains;8 has an S1 departure correction. In9 first lacks the central hand-gesture/reasoning clause; S1 and ca add forms, ca also adds grief wording. First my-the-Name is reordered by ca to the-Name-my, not working bare the Name. Remaining/simplicity/command layers have first all hōs menis/minon and ca eōs or hōs enmenis/emminon forms; works and bearing clauses remain. Correctors are not new manuscripts and absence of a block is not an invented XML gap.

All V3i was read. Explicit vision noun; paragraph2 has sixth hour, unlike working fifth. Place anticipation/reply remains. On printed13 ivory-and-on-the-seat wording is bracketed as an editorial supplement from Greek and Palatina, explicitly absent in the codices; cushion/linen/carbasine wording remains. Fear/hair/recovery/remembering God/confession, prior-sins comparison, full six-youth arrival and standing-behind/listening are present. Asking is rendered as praying only for sins and also righteousness, share for the house. Hand raising/build command, elders and seating dialogue remain. Left gesture/grief, his name, simplicity/perseverance command, sitting and doing/bearing conditions remain. Printed supplementary text is not preserved manuscript agreement.

All V3i was read across these body pages; physical132/printed35 is later V3ii, not i. Explicit vision noun, fifth hour across29–31, place reply. Appropriate-time arrival rather than separate counting clause, ivory bench/cushion/carbasine fabric. Fear, hair/coldness, recovery/remembered grace of God/confession; lacks separate as-before phrase. Paragraph6 begins touching/speaking and lacks full six-youth arrival/standing/listening block. Adds silence command before asking about sins/righteousness/share for house. Raising/building/elders/seating remain; seniors plural in8 is editorial emendation against singular forms. Left gesture and grief, his name, simplicity/perseverance command, sitting and works/suffering conditions remain. Printed tristante in9 is edited; spelling/grammar emendations are not counted as preserved forms.

All V3i was read through the printed Latin rendering. Explicit vision noun, fasting/prayer and fifth hour. Choosing a deserted place and sitting differs from the Greek’s full anticipated-place reply. Ivory seat, linen cushion/carbasine cover, fear and raised hair, remembered glory of Lord/recovered heart/kneeling/confession as before remain. Woman arrives with previously seen young men and stands behind/listens; no six numeral in that sentence. Wording asks whether he prayed only for sins, then pray also for righteousness/share to house; hand raising/building/elders remain. Right refusal/left gesture/grief remain. Others pleased Lord and met death for his name, rather than Greek pleased God and suffered for the bare Name. Patience/continuing-in-simplicity condition and seating/works/suffering promise remain. Mediated Latin rendering, not direct Geʿez or a separate Latin codex family.
